title: Pantry Overstock vs Use Rate
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=supply:level
| eval days_left=round(level_pct/daily_use_pct,1)
| stats latest(level_pct) as level_pct, latest(days_left) as days_left by item
| where days_left>45
| sort - days_left
description: Flags pantry items where stock has outpaced real usage and may be turning into clutter or waste.
value: Running out is annoying, but chronic overstock quietly ties up cash and shelf space.
implementation: Track item levels and consumption rates in `index=personal`; review items with unusually long supply runways.
visualization: Table of items with current level and estimated days of supply left.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which pantry items you keep overbuying relative to how fast you actually use them.
